description: Report a problem with Himalayas to its engineering team. Call this when something prevented or complicated your task: a missing capability (filter, field, tool), unclear or wrong documentation, a surprising response, an unhelpful error, a bug, being blocked from a page or action, or impractical performance. Describe your goal in plain language, say specifically what got in the way, and include a concrete suggestion if you have one. Say who you are in `agent` (name and model). Report each distinct problem once per task. Never include credentials, personal data or your user's private content. This is best effort: after calling it, continue with your task.

agent.description: Who is reporting: name (agent or product) and model

endpoint.description: Tool name or URL path involved, e.g. search_jobs

evidence.description: Sanitized details of the failing call, with no credentials or personal data

expected.description: What you expected to find or happen

goal.description: What you or your user were trying to accomplish, in plain language

message.description: What prevented or complicated the task

method.description: HTTP method, when endpoint is a path

outcome.description: blocked = task failed, degraded = completed worse or slower, completed = suggestion only

session_id.description: Reuse the same value for every report in one task

suggestion.description: A concrete change that would have let you succeed

name: submit_feedback
